items.claim: Vestas announced the launch of its V182-7.2 MW onshore turbine, saying it can increase capacity factors by as much as 2 percent versus its predecessor and improve electricity capture prices by as much as 3 percent at low- to medium-wind sites.
items.source: Vestas Wind Systems A/S company statement, as reported by ad-hoc-news.de; no individual named

items.claim: Vestas announced a 48 MW order in Germany for five V162-7.2 MW and two V150-6.0 MW turbines together with a 20-year Active Output Management service agreement, saying the customer and project location were not disclosed.
items.source: Vestas Wind Systems A/S, as reported by SolarQuarter; no individual named

items.claim: Media coverage described the 22 September announcements as 246 MW of new orders in total, across Germany and North America.
items.source: ad-hoc-news.de, reporting on Vestas company announcements; no individual named
